Subject: Post-demo: subprocessor roster, SOC 2 status & data-flow items

Hi Matt —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get Medicor's legal & security teams what they need: 

Summary from today's demo
- Purpose: Evaluate Redwood for near-real-time clinical summarization in pilot (PHI in scope; HIPAA required).
- Workload: short text generation + embeddings for indexing.
- Anticipated volume: ~100K tokens/day in pilot, spike traffic during batch ingestion.

Action items / asks from Medicor we heard:
1) Confirm Redwood's SOC 2 status and any SOC 2 Type II summary evidence we can share.
2) Subprocessor roster (cloud infra + analytics vendors) and data-flow boundaries for PHI.
3) Complete the Medicor Security Questionnaire (we can start, expect iterative asks).

What I'll send now (attached):
- Redwood_Subprocessors_2028-09-19.xlsx (initial roster, columns: service, provider, region, data types, role)
- SOC2-report-summary-2028Q2.pdf (redacted executive summary)
- Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Initial.pdf (pre-filled answers to common questions)

Proposed next steps
- You: Share any specific evidence redlines or additional controls your legal/security team requires (e.g., data residency, BAAs).
- Us: We'll open the formal questionnaire link and assign an owner (expected turnaround 3 business days for first pass).
- Schedule: Can we book a 30-min security follow-up Thurs or Fri?

If it's helpful I'll also include our dedicated deployment options (VPC / on-prem) and an explicit mapping of which subprocessor touches PHI.

Thanks — more soon.

—

Hi Stephanie —

Appreciate the summary and attachments. A few clarifying questions from our side before we route to security: 

1) On the subprocessor sheet, can you mark which providers may have *transit* access to PHI (e.g., logging/monitoring, APM, backups) vs. those that only process non-PHI? We need explicit PHI touchpoints.
2) SOC 2 summary looks helpful — does Redwood have a full Type II SOC 2 report under NDA? If so, what is the process to request it and how long will that take?
3) For HIPAA specifics: do you have a standard BAA (we can send Medicor's template) or is that negotiated? Any known deviations?

We'd like to get the initial questionnaire answers before sending it to Legal Ops — can you assign an owner and estimate a completion date? Last thing: our security team will want a diagram of how data flows from our EHR -> Redwood API -> storage (if any). A simple sequence diagram would be perfect.

Can you do a short follow-up call Thursday at 11am ET?

Thanks,
Matt
VP, Platform Integrations | Medicor Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 21 Sep 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: subprocessor roster, SOC 2 status & data-flow items

Matt —

Thanks, all good questions. Short answers below and next steps at the bottom. Monica (security) is looped to provide any technical depth you need.

1) Subprocessor PHI touchpoints: we updated the attached spreadsheet with a PHI_Touchpoint column. To summarize:
   - Primary infra: AWS (us-west-2) — compute & storage for hosted customers; AWS S3 logging may be configured to avoid PHI.
   - Monitoring & APM: Datadog (ingests anonymized metrics; no PHI in standard configuration), Sentry (error traces may include snippets — we recommend redaction; we can disable).
   - Analytics: Snowflake (for embeddings index in some dedicated deployments) — only used when customer requests it and contractually restricted.
   - Backups: optional and can be disabled for PHI workloads; default hosted does not persist full request bodies beyond cache TTL unless customer opts in.

2) SOC 2 Type II: yes, Redwood has a Type II report for 2028 Q2. We provide it under NDA — process: sign our standard NDA (we can push via DocuSign) and we'll deliver the redacted PDF within 48 hours of execution.

3) BAA / HIPAA: Redwood has a standard BAA we can share; for Medicor's template we'll engage legal. Typical negotiation window is 7–14 business days for minor edits.

4) Questionnaire owner & timeline: Aditya will own the first pass and expects to return a completed questionnaire for your review within 2 business days (he's cc'd).

5) Data flow diagram: attached (see short ASCII/dataflow below) — we can also provide Visio or draw.io.

----- dataflow (high level) -----
EHR (Medicor) -> HTTPS POST -> Redwood API (ingest service) -> transient KV cache (GPU runtime) -> response returned to Medicor; optional: embeddings pushed to customer-controlled Snowflake (only if enabled). Logs/metrics -> Datadog (no PHI). Backups -> S3 (disabled for PHI unless opted).
---------------------------------

Follow-up call: Thursday 11am ET works for me — booked a 30-min slot and sent a calendar invite.

Attached: updated Redwood_Subprocessors_2028-09-19.xlsx (PHI_Touchpoint column), SOC2-report-summary-2028Q2.pdf, Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Initial.pdf

—
Stephanie Nguyen
